summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The First Trust BuyWrite Income ETF (FTHI) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in total market equity. The fund is an actively managed portfolio of US-listed stocks, with an overlay of short calls on the S&P 500. FTHI was launched on Jan 6, 2014 and is issued by First Trust.

holdings.infoBox: FTHI is an equity ETF with a total of 194 individual holdings. The top holdings are Apple stock at 7.72%, NVIDIA at 7.08%, Dreyfus Govt Cm Inst 289 at 4.91%, Alphabet at 4.15%, and Microsoft at 3.17%.
